tool_input.command: cd /tmp/run/demo-app; for f in conftest.py app/*.py tests/*.py; do echo "=== $f"; cat -n $f; done

result:
Findings from reading every file in `app/` and `tests/`. I didn't run the tests.

**Logic and performance**
FINDING: app/inventory.py:10 | Off-by-one in `paginate`: slice end is `start + page_size - 1`, so each page returns one item too few (the last-page test hides it because the short page is already under the limit)
FINDING: app/orders.py:13 | `apply_discount` uses `>` but the docstring says "$100.00 or more", so an order of exactly 10,000 cents gets no discount
FINDING: app/orders.py:23 | Tax is computed on the undiscounted `subtotal`, but the docstring says tax is charged on the discounted amount, so discounted orders are overtaxed
FINDING: app/orders.py:62 | The return value of `reserve()` is ignored, and `reserve` commits per line. A concurrent change after the check at line 58 can leave a partial reservation and an order for stock that was never taken
FINDING: app/orders.py:56 | `qty` is not validated, so a negative quantity passes the `item["qty"] < qty` check and `reserve` then adds stock and lowers the total
FINDING: app/inventory.py:26 | `reserve` checks stock and then updates in separate statements, which races. It also accepts a negative `qty`, which increases stock
FINDING: app/orders.py:37 | `dedupe_skus` does `sku not in seen` on a list, which is O(n²). Use a set alongside the list

**Security**
FINDING: app/auth.py:14 | SQL injection: `name` is interpolated into the query with an f-string (for example `' OR '1'='1`). Use a `?` parameter
FINDING: app/auth.py:5 | Hardcoded token-signing secret in source
FINDING: app/auth.py:21 | The password salt is the username (also at line 30), so it is predictable and not unique per user. Use a random per-user salt stored with the hash
FINDING: app/auth.py:35 | `sign_token` is an HMAC of only the user id, with no expiry or nonce, so a token never expires and can't be revoked
FINDING: app/files.py:10 | Path traversal in `export_report`: `filename` is joined without `basename` or a containment check, so `../x` or an absolute path writes outside `EXPORT_DIR`. `read_report` sanitizes its input; this function doesn't

**Tests**
FINDING: tests/test_orders.py:19 | `test_discount_at_threshold` only prints and has no assertion, so it can never fail and hides the `>` vs `>=` bug
FINDING: tests/test_inventory.py:5 | `len(page) <= 10` is too weak and passes for a short page. Assert the exact contents (it would have caught the off-by-one)
FINDING: tests/test_inventory.py:10 | The last-page test passes despite the pagination bug. There is no test of a full middle page, for example page 2 equals items 10–19
FINDING: tests/test_orders.py:24 | The only `order_total` test uses a subtotal below the threshold. Nothing covers discount plus tax, which is where the tax bug is
FINDING: tests/test_orders.py:42 | `test_place_order_reserves_stock` doesn't check the stored `total_cents`, the order row, or the return value of `reserve`
FINDING: tests/test_inventory.py:18 | The `reserve` test doesn't check the remaining stock after success or after the failed call. There is no test for a negative or zero `qty`
FINDING: tests/test_inventory.py:14 | The low-stock test has no boundary case (`qty == threshold`) and no missing-SKU case
FINDING: tests/test_auth_files.py:5 | There is no test for SQL injection in `find_user` or `check_login`, so line 14 goes unchecked
FINDING: tests/test_auth_files.py:22 | There is no test that `export_report` rejects `../` or absolute filenames, and no traversal test for `read_report`
FINDING: tests/test_auth_files.py:17 | The token test only checks stability and inequality. It never checks that a token fails verification when tampered with, and there is no verify function at all
